title: dendrophyllanthus ciliaris
intro: Dendrophyllanthus ciliaris, commonly known as the "Fijian wild ginger", is a plant species in the family Annonaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Dendrophyllanthus ciliaris include reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and exhibiting antiviral activity, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are believed to include annonaceous acetogenins, which have been studied for their potential anticancer and neuroprotective effects.
